-- Diagnose Welle-3-Compliance (kein Schema-Aenderung)
SELECT 'paper_trades_cols' AS check, string_agg(column_name, ',' ORDER BY column_name) AS val
FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='trading' AND table_name='paper_trades'
UNION ALL

FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='trading' AND table_name='paper_trade_events'

UNION ALL
SELECT 'paper_trades_status_check', pg_get_constraintdef(oid) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname='paper_trades_status_check';
